notes: Partition verified: 20 source and 26 target tokens each covered once across 19 units (אַרְבָּעָה + עָשָׂר fused into one).
*ye shall have* is distributed by rule 43: הָיָה takes *have*, the לְ is `unrepresented`, and the suffix takes *ye*.
The supplied *the* of *the fourteenth day* is attached to the fused numeral, before which it stands; the competing attachment to *day* is named in that unit's note.
חָג is absolute, so the *of* before *seven* is supplied for the appositional measure and placed on שְׁבֻעוֹת, which is what the ASV renders *seven* (rules 19, 28).
